audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty is framed around 'sidestep Crescent Strike' with no numbers, and the full layer calls Diana 'him/his' throughout (winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[1].t, dontsFull[2].t).
audit.why: The lane is easy pre-6 for a concrete, statable reason: Lunar Rush is 22/20/18/16/14 seconds and is only free when it dashes to a Moonlight-afflicted target. A missed Crescent Strike does not just remove follow-up — it puts her engage on a 22-second timer at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Difficulty grounded on the Moonlight-reset condition and the raw E cooldown; pronouns corrected in every field edited.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five level-chart rows disagree between layers. The full layer reads Skill on all seven rows; the content layer reads Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Skill/Skill/Diana.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Ahri x4, Skill, Skill, Diana), so the full layer is the outlier on rows 1-4 and row 7. A 53.31% win rate over 4710 games with a pre-6 kit advantage supports the content layer, not a flat Skill chart.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side -> Ahri, phases[6].side -> Diana, phases[4] and phases[5] stay Skill. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction of the matchup is absent from both layers: Charm 'instantly stops movement abilities', so it cancels Lunar Rush mid-dash. Nothing on the page says charm interrupts her engage — dosFull[0] only says 'hold charm for his engage' without saying what holding it accomplishes.
audit.why: Riot's E text ('dashing to an enemy') plus Ahri's E text ('instantly stopping movement abilities') is the whole reason Ahri is comfortable into Diana. Without it the advice is 'hold charm', which reads as generic caution rather than a mechanical answer.
audit.corrected: Written into winCon, breakdown.carry and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text says 'Crescent Strike-to-Q combo'. Crescent Strike IS her Q — the combo is Crescent Strike (Q) into Lunar Rush (E).
audit.why: Flagged in packet.defects. The named sequence is self-contradictory and hides the real mechanic: Q applies Moonlight, and Moonlight is what makes E free.
audit.corrected: 'Crescent Strike into Lunar Rush combo — without the Moonlight mark her E is 22 seconds at rank 1'.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text credits Diana with 'Shield of the Ori and armor shred'. There is no item called Shield of the Ori, and Diana deals magic damage — she has no armour shred. whys[6] repeats the 'armor shred' claim.
audit.why: A fabricated item name and a fabricated damage type on the same line. Her real scaling is burst plus Moonfall as a multi-target pull.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Zhonya's/Riftmaker and Moonfall's multi-target pull, which the kit text supports ('increased for each target beyond the first pulled').
sources: brief.enemyKit R text; no armour-shred or true-damage flag on any Diana ability

audit.whatIsWrong: Pale Cascade's shield is never mentioned in either layer.
audit.why: It is 15/13.5/12/10.5/9 seconds and gains extra strength if the third sphere detonates — that is why a straight orb-for-orb trade into a Diana standing in minions loses. It changes the all-in maths and belongs in the bad-trade line.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Crescent Strike as the matchup-defining cooldown and gives no number for anything.
audit.why: Crescent Strike is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 — short enough that waiting it out is not a plan. Lunar Rush at 22 seconds base is the punishable cooldown, and it is only bypassed when a Moonlight mark is live.
audit.corrected: Re-pointed to Lunar Rush with the 22s number and the Moonlight condition.

edits.before: Charm the dive, dash out of the reset, and bleed him with poke he can't answer. Nothing here works through Crescent Strike — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Charm her mid-Lunar Rush — it stops movement abilities dead. Make Crescent Strike miss and her E is 22 seconds at rank 1, so every whiff is a free window for you.

edits.before: Diana wins by landing Crescent Strike, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Diana wins by marking you with Crescent Strike, which makes Lunar Rush free, then holding you inside Moonfall.

edits.before: Q through his last-hit so both hits land, W if he eats the return, and walk — repeat until the charm window is lethal instead of optimistic.
edits.after: Q both ways at 970 while she last-hits — her Crescent Strike reaches only 900, and it is 8 seconds down at rank 1 when she misses.

edits.before: Charming on cooldown for chip damage and then facing his real engage with nothing — the charm is the matchup, not the poke.
edits.after: Trading into Pale Cascade — the shield eats your orb, and if all three spheres detonate it grows again before you finish.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. It governs your forward steps. - R Spirit Rush (last dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Diana Lunar Rush: matchup-defining — free only onto a Moonlight target, otherwise 22s at rank 1. Sidestep the arc and her dive is gone for 20 seconds. - R Spirit Rush (last dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Carry through picks — charm her out of Lunar Rush; it stops movement abilities, and she lands next to you with nothing.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt the map: shove with Q, dash-flank every river, and charm-pick Diana's teammates until the lane lead is a game lead.
edits.after: Ahead, deny her the mark: shove with Q, take river vision, and charm-pick Diana before Lunar Rush ever has a target to reset on.

edits.before: Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Charm instantly stops movement abilities — held for her Lunar Rush, it cancels the dive and leaves her stranded in your wave.

edits.before: Diana whiffs Crescent Strike and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: A whiffed Crescent Strike means no Moonlight — Lunar Rush costs 22s.

edits.before: That is Diana’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Without charm banked, Lunar Rush lands on you for free.

edits.before: Your Charm range and Fox-Fire poke outclass Diana's melee-reliant Crescent Strike-to-Q combo — if she whiffs Crescent Strike she has no way to close the gap, so you dominate these all-ins.
edits.after: Your Charm range and Fox-Fire poke outclass Diana's Crescent Strike into Lunar Rush combo — without the Moonlight mark her E is 22 seconds at rank 1 and she cannot close, so these all-ins are yours.

edits.before: Diana out-scales as a pure burst assassin-mage with Shield of the Ori and armor shred — she can dive backline through your escape tools if she catches you out of position.
edits.after: Diana scales as a burst diver with Zhonya's and Riftmaker — Moonfall pulls your whole side in, and she can reach the backline through your escape tools if you are out of position.

edits.before: Diana's burst and armor shred start outscaling your combo once she has core items and picks her spot — favors her.
edits.after: Diana's burst and Moonfall lockdown start outscaling your combo once she has core items and picks her spot — favors her.
